statements.text: Artificial intelligence replicates exteroceptive, cognitive and linguistic processing well but struggles with the slow, continuous, graded dynamics of interoception, so contemporary AI is poorly suited to modeling the mechanisms that anchor homeostatic feelings and consciousness. Analog and neuromorphic hardware may narrow the gap.
